Let us help make your dreams come true! Schedule your FREE Design Consultation now. CALL NOW: (972) 433-0424 #1 Professional General Contractor specializing in Outdoor Living Solutions. Celina Outdoor Living Solutions is your local go-to backyard contractor for outdoor kitchens, covered porches & patios, stamped or composite decks, fences, pergolas, fire pits, arbors, gazebos, outdoor fireplaces, barns, metal buildings, pools, spas and more - even custom built cabins. Whatever your outdoor project, we can make it happen! The construction process can be frustrating if you don't have the right partner, but our professional North Texas staff will arrive on time, leave a clean work site and make sure that you get the results you've been dreaming of. We only build with the best materials so that you will be able to enjoy your new space for years to come. You already own the space. Let us help you turn that space into your private retreat, so that you can enjoy it whenever and however you like. The weather in North Texas is ideal for year round enjoyment of the outdoors. It is the perfect spot to both entertain or to retreat, to connect with others or escape to your private oasis. There are so many possibilities and configurations available - it really depends on the space you have to work with, how you intend to use it and budget. (Sorry, but that's a legitimate constraint that we all have to work with.) But the beauty with so many options is that it enables you to truly customize your space to fit your needs and choose from a wide range of materials to help you create exactly what you are looking for. Call us at (972) 433-0424 to schedule a free design consultation today! Whether you are looking to add a covered porch, outdoor kitchen and pool to your backyard or finally get around to building that barndominium that you've been dreaming of for so long - Celina Outdoor Living Solutions can help bring your dreams into existence. Name Phone How Can We Help You? Submit Comment Easy 4 Simple Step Process 1 SCHEDULE Schedule your FREE Design Consultation. 2 GET A QUOTE Get all of your questions answered before we start. 3 BUILD We turn your dreams into reality. 4 ENJOY Relax and enjoy your new living space! Services Every project is different. Every client is unique. Outdoor Living Let us help you enjoy the beautiful North Texas weather! Outdoor Kitchens We create functional spaces that look great too! Covered Patios Great spaces that protect from the sun and rain! Pergolas and Decks What do you want to do in your backyard? Fire Pits & Fireplaces Whether heating, cooking or entertaining, we bring the heat! Why Build an Outdoor Living Area? Enjoy the Beautiful North Texas Outdoors The weather in North Texas provides year round opportunities to enjoy outdoor living, with the temperature typically varying between 35 -95 degrees throughout the year. Whether you are looking to build a custom deck, pergola or arbor, maybe extend or add on a covered porch, or create an outdoor kitchen to enable you to be closer to your family and guests - Collin County provides a picturesque backdrop to be able to enjoy the great outdoors from your own backyard. Who doesn't love to gather around a fireplace or fire pit and share stories? Or maybe you're ready to build a pool and hot tub to cool off in the summer and stay warm in the winter? Or perhaps you're looking to build a barn, shed or cabin on your property? Whatever you build to enjoy the great outdoors, North Texas is a great place to do it - and Celina Outdoor Living Solutions would love to help! Invest in Yourself With the recent increase in real estate prices, this is a great time to invest in the property you already own. Where else will you get to enjoy your investment so much? With a current population of more than 30,000 people, the City of Celina's population has nearly tripled since 2010. But that explosive growth is just getting started, as the projected buildout population is around 375,000! Whether you live in Celina, Frisco, Allen, McKinney, Prosper, Anna - people are moving to North Texas in droves. Did you know that Collin County ranked #2 in the entire nation for adding the most residents between July 2020 and July of 2021? The secret is out that we live in an amazing area with great job prospects, strong communities and attractive seasonal weather that still enables you to enjoy the outdoors all year round. Don't put off investing something that will enhance your quality of life. If we learned anything from the pandemic it's that we all can benefit from spending more time outside. Getting out to enjoy the outdoors is good for both our mental and physical health, so making the most of our backyards is great way to do just that. Especially living in Texas where we have relatively mild weather that allows for enjoyment throughout the year, homeowners are finding that investing in expanding their living space outdoors is a great option. Not only does it tend to have a high rate of return financially, the enjoyment factor multiplies that return on investment as you enjoy the space for years to come. That is why a recent survey by Casual Living Magazine found that nearly half (49%) of respondents reported already adding an outdoor living area to their residence. And although an outdoor addition to your home still requires funding, in most cases it is far more affordable when compared to the costs of adding interior living space. Let Celina Outdoor Living Solutions help you extend your living space to the great outdoors. Depending on how you would best utilize your property, there are plenty of options available for every situation. Perhaps entertaining is your goal and building a covered patio, outdoor kitchen and fireplace is a great place to start. Or maybe you're looking to create the perfect backyard oasis and a custom deck, pergola and fire pit is more your style. Then again, this is Texas - so maybe a custom wood barn, a pool & spa and gazebo are more what you're looking for. Whatever you are looking to build, our team is ready to assist you in increasing your quality of life by bringing your outdoor living design to reality. Schedule your free design consultation today. We would love to meet with you to better understand what you are trying to accomplish. And if you're not quite sure exactly what you want to build, our experienced team at Celina Outdoor Living Solutions also has a lot of great ideas to help you think through different construction options.
